memory_candidates.content: BimodalLogic's specs/ROADMAP.md generated '## Run these next' section (rendered by roadmap-integration.sh from state.json's roadmap_notes) can embed a backtick-quoted, verbatim snapshot of a stale hand-authored phrase elsewhere in the file, as part of a roadmap_notes entry describing a correction task's own purpose. This means a plan's own grep-based verification criterion written against the hand-authored occurrence (e.g. 'grep -c <stale phrase> returns 0') can be falsified by this unrelated generated-section quotation surviving, even after the hand-authored occurrence is correctly fixed. Diagnose by checking which '## ' section a surviving grep hit falls inside, not just the raw hit count; a hit inside the generated section is /roadmap's residue, not a failed edit.

BimodalLogic's context/schemas/state-schema.json declares active_projects[].blockers as an array of strings. Task 298's bare-string blockers value is a legacy, non-canonical precedent (normalized away by migrate-state-legacy-fields.sh per state-management-schema.md:161); task 481 is the correct array-of-strings precedent. update-task-status.sh has NO flag that writes blockers at all (grep -n blockers .claude/scripts/update-task-status.sh returns zero hits) -- the field must be added via a direct, scoped Edit to specs/state.json with a unique multi-line anchor, never via a status-mutating script or a jq/Python rewrite (which would reflow the whole file).

scripts/verify-touched.sh is persistently inoperable in BimodalLogic for ANY touched path: .claude/scripts/tests/suite-selection-map.data line 37 names a nonexistent test suite file (test-verification-scope-lib.sh) for scripts/lib/verification-scope-lib.sh. Independently observed in task 829's implement phase and again in task 933's plan and implement phases on 2026-11-19 -- a recurring, not transient, defect. Workaround: name a direct, repo-sanctioned entry point for the specific file type (e.g. validate-state.sh for specs/state.json, roadmap-integration.sh --regenerate --dry-run for specs/ROADMAP.md) in a plan's Tier Justification instead of verify-touched.sh.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic ROADMAP.md generated section can embed stale hand-authored quotations
sapience_notes.value: specs/ROADMAP.md's generated '## Run these next' section (rendered by roadmap-integration.sh from state.json's roadmap_notes) can contain a roadmap_notes entry that quotes a stale hand-authored phrase verbatim, in backticks, as a description of what a correction task will fix. A plan's own grep-based verification criterion written against the hand-authored occurrence can therefore be falsified by this unrelated generated-section quotation surviving, even after the hand-authored occurrence is correctly fixed. Diagnosis: check which '## ' section a surviving grep hit falls inside, not just the hit count.

sapience_notes.subject: roadmap-integration.sh stage-layout retained-section proof
sapience_notes.value: bash scripts/roadmap-integration.sh --regenerate --dry-run against specs/ROADMAP.md, in stage layout, retains every '## ' section byte-for-byte except the one section whose body holds the fenced /orchestrate block ('## Run these next'), which is wholly regenerated from state.json's roadmap_batches/roadmap_notes. Its dry-run output ('layout=stage ... retained=N' plus 'no content change' or a diff) is the authoritative, exit-status-checkable proof that a hand edit to any other section survives the next regeneration.
